description: Generate model pose variations from an input image and either a pose prompt or posture reference image.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the model image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Text prompt describing the target pose.
fields.example: standing naturally with one hand holding the product

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

example.prompt: standing naturally with one hand holding the product
